summary: Produced the backend design artefact for ADP-01 at src/design/adp-01-tenant-column-event-store.md. The design specifies additive tenant_id introduction for events/events_archive, default-tenant backfill compatibility, tenant-scoped append/read/global stream contracts, index strategy, API-context-to-storage propagation assumptions, deterministic failure behavior for missing/invalid tenant context, and explicit traceability to ADP-01 plus impacted ES-01/02/04/06/07 with ADP-11 interaction.

tests_run.name: design completeness and acceptance traceability review
tests_run.detail: Verified all handoff acceptance criteria are explicitly mapped to schema/index behavior, read/write/query contracts, failure modes, and prior-requirement regression points.
